description:
[Game reference] NPC vending machines and shopkeepers: every shop, offer and price. Every NPC shop in the game files (Outpost, Bandit Camp, fishing villages, stables, water wells, floating
cities, the Travelling Vendor, plus order sets no standard monument uses). `order_sets` carry `key`, `title`,
`offers` (`sell` item, `sell_amount`, `sell_bp`, `currency` item, `price`, `price_text`, and `random` - weight
and price range - for shops that show 7 random offers: `picks`), and `where` (monuments, with
`dynamic_pricing`). `locations` lists the shops per monument. Listed prices are the base: with dynamic
pricing (the default) a scrap price starts at double on a fresh map and drifts between half and double with
demand every few hours; water-well shopkeepers, the Travelling Vendor and deep-sea vendors keep the listed
price. With `item`, `sold` and `bought` list just that item's offers. Cached for one hour. Use item= for 'where can I buy X' / 'what can I sell X for'. Prices are the listed base; most NPC shops move between half and double with demand. Link https://rust.wiki/vending.

item.description: Only offers that sell this item or take it as payment (shortname, e.g. `rifle.ak` or `scrap`).

monument.description: Only the shops at this monument (slug from `/monuments`, e.g. `outpost`).
